properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with the low pressure system  located several hundred miles southwest of the Azores have changed  little in organization during the past several hours. A tropical  depression could still form later today. The system is expected to  move slowly over the next couple of days, remaining southwest of the  Azores, followed by a turn to the southwest by early next week.  Environmental conditions are forecast to become less favorable for  development beginning Sunday night or on Monday.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...80 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

Showers and thunderstorms associated with a broad area of low  pressure located well south-southwest of the southwestern coast of  Mexico remain disorganized. Environmental conditions are conducive  for development, and a tropical depression is expected to form late  this weekend or early next week while it moves generally northward  off the coast of southwestern Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...70 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

Showers and thunderstorms associated with an area of low pressure  located well southwest of the southern tip of the Baja California  Peninsula remain disorganized. Environmental conditions are  conducive for development, and a tropical depression is expected to  form this weekend as it moves westward to west-northwestward at 10  to 15 mph across the western East Pacific. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...80 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (Former TD 15-E)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with the remnants of Tropical  Depression Fifteen-E, located well east of the Hawaiian Islands,  remain disorganized. Environmental conditions appear conducive for  some development of this system next week as it moves westward to  west-southwestward, and a tropical depression could form well to the  south or southeast of the Hawaiian Islands by the middle to latter  part of next week. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...50 percent.
